bars.description: Candidate A–A–B–A–B: source writes A8+A8+B8; the recording suggests a da capo without repeating its first strain again. After the first complete traversal, return at the G-sharp pickup in bar8's last eighth, then bars9–24. Do not duplicate the complete AAB source as if the da capo retained its written-out initial repeat; verify both A/B returns independently.

provenance: EXT: All four unchanged sounding Liu piano voices are extracted separately; these are notation identities, not recovered recorded hands. MEAS: 497 canonical voice events / 404 distinct pitch-onset pairs versus legacy 402/402 comprise 93 coincident voice-unisons and two genuinely missing A2 quarter attacks at q7.5/q23.5 (bars 4/12; bassvoices a4, source lines 208/216) beneath bassvoicestwo A2 ties starting q6/q22 (lines 245–246/254–255). Both independent attacks and held voices are retained.

MEAS: Two A1 grace onsets relocate from q8.3697917/q24.3697917 to q8.3854167/q24.3854167 under modern LilyPond; they are not new main notes. Eleven shared-note duration differences are written-staccato playback policy, and two are grace-adjacent tie gates. Those A2 ties have written spans of 2.5Q; rendered MIDI gates are 2.3854167Q because the following grace steals time. These realizations do not establish measured recording key releases. No source pitch, repeat or written rest is removed; recording edition remains provisional.

Read content/listen/schumann-kinderszenen-happiness.mjs and cache/analysis/schumann-kinderszenen-happiness.txt. Harmonic trajectories suggest A0–28, B28–46, A46–68, B68–90; these are coarse, not forced alignment anchors.
